summary.text: Scott Bryer is a Republican state representative from Rockingham 1 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He works as an administrator at the New Hampshire Department of Safety.

paragraphs.text: Scott Bryer earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Massachusetts Boston and a graduate degree from Southern New Hampshire University.
His career experience includes working as an administrator at the New Hampshire Department of Safety.
He took office in the New Hampshire House on December 4, 2024.
